headline: Late-session NQ rebound lifts Tail to upper-WATCH into expiration close
body: Webull displays December NQ near the session high after a broad intraday round trip from the session low. Treasury yields above 5%, oil above $100 and quarterly expiration keep Stress extreme. The session's substantial two-way movement prevents a block-level Tail assessment without verified repeated extension or failed retracements.
